name: owl-bt-ts
description: Behavior tree editor (TypeScript + React rewrite of owl-bt)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @owlbt/server" "npm run dev -w @owlbt/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @owlbt/client && npm run build -w @owlbt/server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @owlbt/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build -w @owlbt/desktop && npm run dist -w @owlbt/desktop
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run build -w @owlbt/desktop && npm run dist:dir -w @owlbt/desktop
scripts.package:current: npm run build && npm run build -w @owlbt/desktop && npm run dist:current -w @owlbt/desktop
